title: Bluesky wants to make it easier to buy, sell, and fundraise on the network
slides: Can Bluesky turn posts into profit?
New tools let creators sell directly on the network
But payments work differently than you expect
You can now fundraise without leaving your feed
Test one paid post this week
thread_text:
1. Bluesky's paid post bet

Bluesky now lets creators sell directly on the network. But payments don't work like you think.

2. No middleman needed

You can fundraise right from your feed. No external links, no third-party checkout.

3. The twist: split payments

Money doesn't go straight to your bank. It routes through a different system than you expect.

4. One post, one payout

Test a single paid post this week. See how the payment flow actually feels.

5. Your turn to test

Take one real post and try the paid feature. Does it make sense for your audience?

script: Bluesky now lets you sell posts directly.
You can fundraise without leaving your feed.
But payments don't work like you expect.
One paid post this week will show you.
Try it and see if it fits.

instagram.caption:
You can now sell a post directly on Bluesky without linking out to another checkout 🧵

Bluesky is building tools to buy, sell, and fundraise right inside the network. No external links needed.

The catch: payments don't go straight to your bank. They route through a different system than you'd expect 💸

Fundraising also works straight from your feed, so followers can pay without leaving the app.

If you publish content, this means one more place to earn — but you'll need to learn how the payout flow actually works first.

Would you try charging for a single post this week? 👀
